programme.title: O Pequeno Corpo
programme.desc: Itália, 1900. Agata é uma jovem mulher que embarca numa viagem desesperada para alcançar um santuário misterioso, a fim de salvar a alma da sua filha da condenação eterna do Limbo.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Visita Guiada
programme.desc: Em 1130, Coimbra torna-se o centro da expansão de D. Afonso Henriques contra os muçulmanos. A carência de recursos do Condado Portucalense é colmatada por um casamento estratégico, viabilizando a conquista de Lisboa. A última campanha militar de D. Afonso Henriques, em Badajoz, marca o fim do seu reinado expansionista. Esta é a terceira etapa de uma viagem pela vida do rei, guiada pelo medievalista Luís Carlos Amaral.

programme.title: Cinco Dias, Cinco Noites
programme.desc: No Portugal dos anos 40, André, com apenas 19 anos foge da prisão e vê-se obrigado a abandonar o país recorrendo a Lambaça, um contrabandista que conhece bem a fronteira. Durante 5 dias e 5 noites atravessam montes e vales com destino a Espanha, nascendo entre os dois uma forte amizade.

programme.title: Paixão Segundo São João por Sasha Waltz
programme.desc: Para o 300.º aniversário da "Paixão Segundo São João" de Bach, a Opéra de Dijon apresentou uma reinterpretação notável. Sasha Waltz (encenação e coreografia) e Leonardo García Alarcón (direção musical) transformaram a obra numa exploração universal da procura humana por verdade, justiça e esperança. A fusão da música de Bach com a dança de Waltz criou uma experiência cénica de fervor espiritual e teatralidade, oferecendo consolo perante temas de poder e redenção.

programme.title: Cinemax
programme.desc: Cinemax é um programa dedicado ao universo da curta-metragem e à relevância deste formato na descoberta de novos talentos e valorização de autores clássicos. O Cinemax garante a exibição regular de curtas-metragens, complementada por breves entrevistas que apresentam os seus autores.

programme.title: Rebobinar Depois de Ver
programme.desc: Uma reflexão com linguagem despretensiosa, a análise sobre o contexto cultural e artístico de alguns filmes importantes da história mundial do Cinema.

programme.title: Debaixo das Figueiras
programme.desc: Num pomar tunisino, jovens colhedoras de figos partilham anseios e frustrações. Amor, casamento e família são debatidos sob o olhar das figueiras, enquanto a dinâmica patriarcal da sociedade molda os seus destinos. Entre namoriscos e desilusões, o grupo questiona o futuro, num filme sensível sobre a juventude tunisina contemporânea, apresentado em Cannes.

programme.title: HELPO - Ruínas do Rio
programme.desc: Este documentário, realizado pela moçambicana Yara Costa, é um relato das histórias de coragem e superação de sobreviventes do Idai, na região de Dombe, província de Manica, onde a HELPO constituiu a Missão de Emergência para o apoio às populações afetadas pelo ciclone.

programme.desc: O podcast "ScienceCast - Uma Conversa com Ciência", apresentado pelo jornalista Vasco Matos Trigo, satisfaz a curiosidade humana. Transforma o conhecimento em diálogo dinâmico com investigadores, gestores e comunicadores. As suas temáticas abrangem desde as ciências naturais e engenharias até à música, história e sociais, quebrando barreiras disciplinares e criando pontes entre diversas áreas do saber.

programme.title: Remo: Campeonatos do Mundo de Remo de Praia - Finais (Resumo)
programme.desc: Os Campeonatos do Mundo de Remo de Praia decorreram entre 18 a 21 de outubro de 2026 em Qingdao, China.

programme.title: Basquetebol: Geórgia x Portugal - FIBA Campeonato do Mundo de Basquetebol 2027 - 2ª Fase de Qualificação (Direto)
programme.desc: A Seleção Nacional de Basquetebol encontra-se na segunda fase de qualificação para o Campeonato do Mundo de 2027, integrando o Grupo I ao lado de Espanha, Ucrânia, Montenegro, Grécia e Geórgia. Entre as 24 melhores equipas europeias, Portugal disputará seis jogos cruciais entre agosto de 2026 e março de 2027, mantendo os resultados da ronda anterior. O objetivo é conquistar um dos três lugares de acesso ao Mundial do Qatar, transformando uma campanha histórica numa inédita qualificação.

programme.title: Salto Mortal
programme.desc: Na história da ginástica em Portugal, que se inicia a partir de meados do século XIX, encontramos práticas diferentes: Primeiro a ginástica acrobática, depois a ginástica sueca e, nos anos 30 do século XX, a ginástica respiratória ou portuguesa. Daí para a frente a evolução tem sido enorme.

programme.title: Voleibol Feminino: Liga Solverde.pt Feminina - V. Guimarães x Sporting CP
programme.desc: Está de regresso a principal competição do voleibol feminino português. A Liga Solverde.pt 2026/27 arranca a 11 de outubro de 2026, reunindo 12 equipas numa temporada que se prolonga pela primavera de 2027, com a fase regular e os respetivos play-offs a decidirem o novo campeão nacional. Em competição estarão FC Porto, SC Braga, SL Benfica, Sporting CP, Leixões SC, PV Colégio Efanor, Vitória SC, Clube Kairós, Castêlo da Maia GC, AA São Mamede, CD Fiães e GC Vilacondense.

programme.title: Os Chapéus de Chuva de Cherburgo
programme.desc: Geneviève, uma adolescente de 17 anos de idade, vive com a mãe e ajuda-a na sua loja de chapéus de chuva em Cherburgo. Apesar da reprovação da mãe, namora Guy, um jovem mecânico. Os dois sonham com o futuro e juram amar-se para sempre. Porém, Guy é convocado para a Guerra da Argélia. Antes de se separarem, Geneviève e Guy passam a noite juntos num gesto de compromisso que será desafiado pela passagem do tempo. Um dos mais belos filmes do cinema francês, com uma atmosfera de mágica melancolia, onde dois apaixonados, separados pela guerra, enfrentam os desafios do destino num musical que transforma diálogos quotidianos em canções sobre amor, perda e escolhas irreversíveis.

programme.title: Episódios da Vida
programme.sub-title: A Sra. Fozzard Encontra o seu Caminho
programme.desc: A Sra. Fozzard (Maxine Peake) tem um novo podólogo, o Sr. Dunderdale, embora, tecnicamente, ele esteja reformado. Mas as suas consultas semanais levantam rapidamente uma questão pertinente: quem está a tratar quem?

programme.title: Rebobinar Depois de Ver
programme.desc: Uma reflexão com linguagem despretensiosa, a análise sobre o contexto cultural e artístico de alguns filmes importantes da história mundial do Cinema.

programme.title: Breve História de uma Família
programme.desc: Wei não corresponde às expectativas dos pais de classe média. Conhece Shuo, seu oposto: introvertido, estudioso e com vida familiar difícil. Ao convidá-lo para casa, Shuo torna-se figura habitual, o "filho ideal" que os pais de Wei sempre desejaram.

programme.title: Gileno Santana - Miles Davis Legacy: A Kind of Blue
programme.desc: O trompetista Gileno Santana, devoto de Miles Davis, reúne músicos de excelência para uma vibrante homenagem ao álbum "Kind of Blue". Este projeto proporciona uma experiência ao vivo irrepreensível do clássico de jazz, ideal para os seus amantes, e celebra o legado do ícone norte-americano, reafirmando Santana como um dos grandes da nova geração.

programme.title: In Music
programme.desc: André Santos, guitarrista e compositor, interpreta três temas de sua autoria e fala sobre o seu percurso e sobre a sua composição.

programme.title: Playtime - Vida Moderna
programme.desc: O Sr. Hulot, um homem adoravelmente antiquado, tenta contactar um oficial em Paris, mas a cidade, repleta de tecnologia moderna, revela-se um labirinto despersonalizante. Perdido entre excursões de turistas americanas, Hulot deambula, provocando o caos característico. Este filme de Jacques Tati, considerado uma obra-prima, é uma visão cómica e surreal da luta humana contra a desumanização num mundo de alta tecnologia.

programme.title: Mulheres Que Contam
programme.sub-title: Dorina Lindemann - Enóloga, Produtora de Vinhos na Quinta da Plansel
programme.desc: Dorina Lindemann nasceu na Alemanha, numa zona de vinhos, em Neustadt Weinstrasse. Na realidade, a sua ligação a Portugal começa por um acaso, por uma espécie de naufrágio do pai, em 1961. Hans Jorg Bohm , velejando a caminho das Seicheles, teve de fazer uma paragem forçada em Cascais.

programme.title: Faça Chuva Faça Sol
programme.desc: "Faça Chuva Faça Sol" é um magazine semanal que desvenda a agricultura e floresta portuguesas, explorando a inovação, sustentabilidade e os novos protagonistas do setor. O programa oferece uma visão moderna do mundo rural, onde tradição e tecnologia se fundem. Através de casos concretos de norte a sul, mostra o crescimento, valor e as abordagens sustentáveis que tornam a agricultura um pilar fundamental para o futuro económico de Portugal, revolucionando a sua perceção.

programme.title: Biosfera
programme.desc: A ilha do Porto Santo é candidata a reserva da biosfera da UNESCO, galardão que enfatiza, sobretudo a harmonia da relação entre o Homem e as suas atividades e o meio envolvente.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Criar.pt
programme.sub-title: Pixel Panties - Cesária Martins e Sebastião Teixeira
programme.desc: Já reparou nos objetos que tornam o nosso quotidiano extraordinário? Peças que nos rodeiam, que muitas vezes passam despercebidas, mas que são não só criações geniais como de alguém. Que percurso faz uma ideia desde o momento que germina até ao momento em que ganha vida própria?

programme.title: ScienceCast
programme.sub-title: Maria Clara Gomes - Biomateriais: Regenerar Tecidos, Transformar a Medicina
programme.desc: O podcast "ScienceCast - Uma Conversa com Ciência", apresentado pelo jornalista Vasco Matos Trigo, satisfaz a curiosidade humana. Transforma o conhecimento em diálogo dinâmico com investigadores, gestores e comunicadores. As suas temáticas abrangem desde as ciências naturais e engenharias até à música, história e sociais, quebrando barreiras disciplinares e criando pontes entre diversas áreas do saber.

programme.title: Jovens Cientistas dos Açores
programme.desc: Série documental que acompanha, através de entrevistas e depoimentos, o percurso de vida e as aspirações de 12 jovens cientistas no arquipélago dos Açores.

programme.title: Molang
programme.desc: Molang é uma série infantil com um olhar afetuoso e bem-humorado sobre a amizade entre um coelho excêntrico, alegre e entusiasta e Piu Piu, um pintainho tímido, discreto e sentimental.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Pablo é um menino autista de 5 anos e meio inteligente e artístico, cujos desenhos imaginativos ganham vida, permitindo que ele enfrente o mundo real com confiança. Usando os seus lápis mágicos, Pablo transforma os seus desafios diários em aventuras fantásticas!

programme.title: Mush-Mush e os Mushimelos
programme.desc: Mush-Mush quer o Starmush a viver na aldeia para responder às suas perguntas.

programme.title: Kiri e Lou
programme.desc: Numa floresta de papel recortado e com criaturas feitas de argila, Kiri, um pequeno dinossauro mal-humorado com emoções avassaladoras e Lou, uma criatura gentil e atenciosa, podem parecer os melhores amigos mais improváveis.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Bing Bunny é uma série baseada nos livros infantis do autor e ilustrador Ted Dewan. Celebra as realidades, a aprendizagem e a aventura de ser uma criança do pré-escolar quando a vida está repleta de dramas quotidianos, tanto para as crianças como para os adultos.

programme.title: Weather Hunters
programme.desc: Criada pelo apresentador Al Roker, esta série segue Lily Hunter, uma génio da meteorologia de oito anos, e a sua família curiosa, explorando o fascinante mundo do clima. Desde a chuva ao nevoeiro, passando por fenómenos extremos como furacões, a série utiliza aventuras emocionantes, humor e temas STEM para desvendar a ciência do tempo de forma divertida e acessível a todos.

programme.title: A Ovelha Choné
programme.desc: Ovelha Choné? Pois esta ovelha é um pouco excêntrica, como o nome indica! Aventuras cheias de humor na quinta, sob a supervisão do Agricultor e de Bitzer, o cão pastor.

programme.title: Dinoster: Os Heróis Quânticos
programme.desc: Acompanha as aventuras de quatro amigos que aparentam levar uma vida normal, mas viajam em segredo para a Dino Terra para estudar os dinossauros e salvá-los do perigo. É a equipa Dinoster!

programme.title: As Aventuras de Lia
programme.desc: Na medieval Cidade da Névoa, Lia é uma heroína ágil, astuta e irreverente. Saltando de telhado em telhado ou disfarçada, ela lidera os seus inseparáveis companheiros – um cavaleiro trapalhão, um bobo da corte com o seu fantoche falador, e três furões. Juntos, desvendam mistérios, apanham bandidos e dão lições a nobres tirânicos, sempre com coragem, inteligência e soluções divertidas para salvar o dia.

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS é um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciência e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Minúsculo (5 Minutos)
programme.desc: Os nossos pequenos heróis de "Minúsculo" estão de volta com uma nova série de divertidas e surpreendentes aventuras. Desde o tranquilo campo e as montanhas envoltas em neve até às ruas de Paris e às praias ensolaradas, os nossos amigos insetos vêem-se envolvidos em situações repletas de comédia, ação, suspense e poesia. Combinando animação CGI com belíssimas paisagens filmadas ao vivo, "Minúsculo" conta as suas histórias com charme e humor, sem qualquer diálogo ou comentário.

programme.title: Grizzy e os Lemingues
programme.desc: Grizzy, o urso, e a família mais desmiolada de sempre, os Lemingues, estão de volta para novas, atribuladas e divertidas aventuras desta vez numa viagem pelo mundo!

programme.title: Luke, o Viajante no Tempo
programme.desc: Luke é um rapaz que viaja para vários mundos e épocas diferentes dentro de um elevador muito especial: um elevador que viaja no tempo! Uma emocionante aventura com Luke está prestes a começar!

programme.title: Luke, o Viajante no Tempo
programme.desc: Luke é um rapaz que viaja para vários mundos e épocas diferentes dentro de um elevador muito especial: um elevador que viaja no tempo! Uma emocionante aventura com Luke está prestes a começar!

programme.title: Zoe e Milo
programme.desc: Zoe e Milo são duas crianças de dez anos. Eles não são apenas vizinhos que vivem numa cidade grande, são os melhores amigos. E também são aventureiros: viajam pelo mundo num avião construído e pilotado por Alim, um hamster.

programme.title: Index
programme.desc: Com duas temáticas diferentes por dia, o "Index" é um quizz que coloca o espectador à prova e ainda dá a conhecer várias curiosidades.

programme.title: Somos Academia
programme.desc: A Europa atravessa a maior crise de segurança desde a 2a Guerra Mundial. Como percecionam os jovens esta realidade e que impactos acreditam que esta pode vir a ter no seu futuro.

programme.title: Laji, Histórias de Refugiados em Portugal
programme.desc: Amir foi perseguido por motivos de religião, Lana pelas opiniões acerca dos direitos das mulheres; Ahmed e Naji fugiram à guerra. Portugal recebeu nos últimos anos mais de três mil refugiados ao abrigo de diferentes protocolos internacionais de ajuda.

programme.title: Folha de Sala
programme.desc: Uma agenda cultural que destaca espectáculos de teatro, música e outros, não esquecendo o lançamento de livros e discos, o cinema e ainda a realização de outros eventos, como exposições, espectáculos ao ar livre, conferências. Texto e locução de Manuela Silva Reis.

programme.title: A Família Hardacre
programme.desc: Os Hardacres resolveram a situação, mas surge uma notícia bombástica e inesperada... Será que vão conseguir reencontrar o caminho de volta enquanto família?

programme.title: Fotobox
programme.desc: Programa sobre fotografia. A tecnologia, os fotógrafos e as suas fotografias têm uma presença assegurada neste programa.

programme.title: A Fé dos Homens
programme.desc: Espaço dedicado às diferentes religiões reconhecidas em Portugal e instituídas através de uma Igreja própria.

programme.title: Madeira Profunda
programme.desc: Os lugares, o povo, as tradições, as particularidades escondidas de sítios da ilha da Madeira até agora pouco conhecidos. Ao longo de 12 episódios propomos dar a conhecer uma outra realidade deste arquipélago.

programme.title: Sociedade Civil
programme.desc: O Sociedade Civil é um programa com História que quer fazer cada vez mais parte do dia-a-dia de todos os portugueses. São questões públicas debatidas por gente distinta, temas particulares apresentados de forma clara. Apresentado pelo jornalista Luís Castro, de segunda a sexta-feira, às 14h00.

programme.title: Causa Própria
programme.desc: A investigação continua. Os inspetores Mário e Maria visitam a escola da vítima, voltam a interrogar o guarda do jardim e fazem descobertas improváveis. Um email anónimo leva-os a seguir uma nova linha de investigação.

programme.title: Passagem de Nível
programme.desc: O comboio chegou ao coração do Alentejo há 160 anos. Dá-se uma revolução de espaço-tempo. E hoje? Até onde o podem levar as velhas carruagens que circulam na linha do Alentejo? Os alentejanos desejam circular até ao aeroporto de Beja ou diretamente até Faro. Mas o sonho permanece sem resposta.

programme.title: Gabinete de Curiosidades
programme.desc: No "Gabinete de Curiosidades" são apresentados vários curiosidades culturais e históricas. De frases intrigantes, à análise de filmes, de pessoas interessantes, a lugares inesperados.

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: Os Numberblocks são um grupo de números muito divertido que trabalham juntos para resolver grandes e pequenos problemas e vão ensinar-te a contar de uma forma muito divertida!

programme.title: Sericórnio: Chuva de Estrelas
programme.desc: Na sequência dos acontecimentos do Eclipse Lunar, Astra e a sua equipa de Sericórnios partem à procura do lendário Reino dos Sericórnios. Pelo caminho, descobrem segredos há muito escondidos, fazem novas amizades e enfrentam inimigos poderosos. Entre desafios, poderes por dominar e uma perigosa força das trevas, a amizade, a coragem e o trabalho em equipa serão fundamentais para proteger os oceanos e o seu universo mágico.

programme.title: Descomplica
programme.desc: Porque é que sentimos medo? Será que existem coisas de meninas e coisas de meninos? A nossa memória é infinita? Porque gostamos tanto de jogar e ver coisas no telemóvel? Afinal o que é ser criativo? Existem pessoas mais e menos bonitas? Andamos a cuidar bem do nosso planeta? Ufffa tantas perguntas..

programme.title: Radar XS
programme.desc: Radar XS é um telejornal para crianças dos 8 aos 12 anos onde se pretende incentivar o pensamento crítico e a cidadania consciente. Vamos juntar a política e a cultura, a economia e desporto, a ciência e a literatura infantil, a atualidade nacional e internacional numa linguagem simples e objetiva.

programme.title: Samuel
programme.desc: Samuel, um rapaz tímido de 10 anos começa a escrever um diário para processar os seus sentimentos, os primeiros amores, as amizades complexas e a transição da escola primária para o início da adolescência. Uma série de animação criada por Emilie Tronche.

programme.title: Prova Oral
programme.desc: O famoso programa diário da Antena 3 é uma instituição com 20 anos e ganhou a forma de programa televisivo semanal. Fernando Alvim, com ajuda intercalada de Joana Gama e Diana Duarte, entrevista em estúdio gente do momento, com as perguntas que todos desejam e as reações dos espetadores.

programme.title: Hope!
programme.desc: Já abordámos muitos setores e soluções, mas parece faltar algo para conseguirmos reduzir as emissões de CO2 na atmosfera. Temos de abordar o problema dos nossos oceanos e garantir que erradicamos a desigualdade.

programme.title: Break The Wall
programme.desc: "Break The Wall" é uma série de entrevistas onde Tomás Duran analisa rigorosamente o papel dos media na sociedade contemporânea. Explora a evolução tecnológica, modelos de produção e narrativas que moldam a perceção pública, integrando uma componente artística com monitores antigos. Profissionais portugueses debatem o funcionamento das redações, desafios éticos, o impacto da IA e a adaptação contínua, resultando num retrato humanizado da complexidade do ecossistema mediático.

programme.title: Jornal 2
programme.desc: O mundo em 30 minutos. No Jornal 2 analisamos factos e cruzamos opiniões. A cada dia que passa fazemos leitura do país e do mundo com dados, explicações e interpretações nas mais diversas áreas, como Política, Ciência, Economia e Cultura.

programme.title: Escola de Enfermagem
programme.desc: Fredenslund ficou marcada pelo incêndio. Um dos alunos continua em coma com queimaduras graves e, no meio do caos, Anna vê-se envolvida numa tarefa complicada.

A Escrava Isaura
programme.desc: Remake dupa cunoscuta serie din 1976, serialul se constituie intr-o tumultoasa istorie a vietii sclavei Isaura, o tanara de culoare alba.\n\nNascuta in 1885, la ferma comandantului Almeida din Campos, tanara Isaura este fiica frumoasei sclave Juliana si a administratorului fermei Miguel. programme.desc: Emisiunea Connect își propune să prezinte săptămânal cele mai noi și interesante gadgeturi, de la cele mai cunoscute telefoane, laptopuri, wearables, aplicații și jocuri, la cele mai inedite proiecte care țin capetele de afiș ale presei de tehnologie din toată lumea.

programme.title: Sănătate cu stil
programme.desc: Prezentatoarea emisiunii aduce în atenţia telespectatorilor o serie întreagă de afecţiuni, cu care se confruntă tot mai mulţi români, şi oferă cele mai bune soluţii şi remedii pentru acestea, cu ajutorul celor mai buni medici din România. programme.title: Schimb de mame
programme.desc: Emisiunea "Schimb de mame" aduce în prim plan experienţele inedite trăite de soțiile-mame care au curajul să își schimbe viaţa pentru șapte zile. În fiecare săptămînă, două soții-mame vor face "schimb de vieți", vor avea o familie, prieteni și o slujbă complet noi, într-o localitate și o casa cu totul necunoscute. La final, protagoniștii se vor întâlni pentru a-și împărtăși experienţele trăite în răstimpul celor șapte zile și vor fi premiați.

programme.desc: 'S1/E101'. Sibongile breaks up with Kwenzo. Vusi confronts Njengaye about his love child. Nomfundo tries getting one of the helpers to take Sibongile's job and look after Wenzeni.

programme.title: Nyala O...
programme.desc: 'S1/E58 of 84'. Kea uncovers the truth behind Bomma's mysterious powder. Ernest shifts his attention to Lebo, while Lerato can no longer resist Zondo.

programme.title: Kwa Baba
programme.desc: 'S1/E131'. Dumisani exploits a family shock to strengthen his position. Bahumi and Solomon grow closer as a major life change approaches. Mhlaba risks everything to protect livelihoods.

programme.title: Inyosi
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. Buhle settles into her new role at Ekhaya, eager to prove herself and learn from Mabongi. As the business and family become increasingly complicated, Mabongi finds herself racing against a deadline she cannot control.

programme.title: Inimba
programme.desc: 'S2/E196'. Desperate to save Mabandla Lifestyle, Xolani risks his future while Thandeka proposes an unthinkable solution. As Mawethu dreams of marriage, Portia's hesitation gives Azande reason to hope.

programme.title: Homecoming
programme.desc: 'S2/E117'. Shwabi's paranoia spirals out of control as mysterious messages and haunting images of Shobane push him closer to breaking point. Meanwhile, Spha becomes intoxicated by fast money and dangerous power.

programme.title: Sip And Talk
programme.desc: 'S2/E6'. Dineo sits down with Maraza and Nolo Matlaila to unpack the pressures of life in the spotlight, public setbacks and the challenging journey of rebuilding your identity.

programme.title: Nyale
programme.desc: A young woman receives a rude awakening when the will her father left reveals that she can only get her inheritance after she gets married.

programme.title: Bopapago
programme.desc: Four fathers start an undercover absent-father-busting operation in their township. One of their clients sends them on a mission to uncover family secrets.

programme.title: Along Came Jones
programme.desc: Melody Jones (Gary Cooper) is a laid-back cowboy who gets lost on the trail and ends up in the small town of Payneville. Grateful for her help, Jones falls for de Cherry, not knowing that she is Jarrad's girl and that she plans on using him to help Jarrad elude capture.

programme.title: Cattle Annie and Little Britches
programme.desc: Two teenage girls rally what's left of the Doolin-Dalton outlaw gang after Doolin is caught.

programme.title: Barquero
programme.desc: Jake Remy (Warren Oates) and his band of mercenaries shoot their way through a tiny border town, planning to escape with their plunder across the river into Mexico. They dispatch a few men to neutralize the local ferryman, Travis (Lee Van Cleef), but he and flinty mountain man Phil (Forrest Tucker) foil the scheme. By the time Jake reaches the river, Travis has already taken everyone from the town to the Mexican side. He refuses passage to the mercenaries, and a lengthy standoff ensues.

programme.title: Robbers' Roost
programme.desc: An outlaw attempting to go straight while tracking down one of his wife's killers, Jim "Tex" Wall (George Montgomery) finds work on a ranch operated by disabled cattle owner "Bull" Herrick (Bruce Bennett). As Tex begins to fall for Bull's pretty sister, Helen (Sylvia Findley), he also has to face off against two feuding gangs of rustlers, one led by the tough Heesman (Peter Graves). Can Tex escape his shady past and finally end his mission of vengeance?

programme.title: Southwest Passage
programme.desc: Edward Beale (Rod Cameron) and his caravan are en route to California as part of the U.S. Cavalry's initiative to utilize camels as cargo carriers for desert treks. Beale and his men join up with an escaped bank robber, Clint McDonald (John Ireland), who is impersonating a doctor. When one of Beale's men discovers McDonald's fraud, he blackmails the thief for a share of the bank loot. But then a far more menacing threat emerges in the form of American Indian warriors.

programme.title: Five Guns West
programme.desc: Five criminals are recruited by the Confederacy for a dangerous mission in exchange for a pardon. The men -- John Morgan Candy (Bob Campbell), William Parcel Candy (Jonathan Haze), J.C. Haggard (Paul Birch), Hale Clinton (Touch Connors) and Govern Sturges (John Lund) -- are to travel to Kansas to intercept a stagecoach carrying Confederate traitor and spy Stephen Jethro (Jack Ingram) and gold. However, when they realize that a woman (Dorothy Malone) is also present, it complicates their mission.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Half-Apache Pardon Chato (Charles Bronson) finds himself in a bar fight with a bigoted sheriff and kills the man to save his own life. The locals won't accept this defense, though, and angry Civil War veteran Quincey Whitmore (Jack Palance) rounds up a gang of toughs to track down Chato, who is forced to flee the scene. But when the posse finds Chato's family and brutalizes them, the escapee decides it's time to stop running and start taking revenge on the lynch mob.

programme.title: God Forgives, I Don't
programme.desc: Psychotic bandit Bill San Antonio kills all the passengers on a train and steals a fortune in gold. Hutch Bessy, an insurance investigator, and his gunslinger partner, Cat Stevens, go on the hunt for Bill, hoping to retrieve the loot. Unfortunately, outlaws take Hutch and Cat prisoner. Cat manages to get away and saves Hutch's life. When Cat is kidnapped later by other crooks, Hutch has to reciprocate. But they still have Bill to worry about.

programme.title: The Hills Run Red
programme.desc: Confederate soldiers Jerry Brewster (Thomas Hunter) and Ken Seagull (Nando Gazzolo) steal a fortune from the U.S. Army. But, when the partners in crime are ambushed by Union troops, they have to split up; Seagull escapes with the money, and Brewster gets a five-year jail sentence. When Brewster gets out, he discovers that his old crony is responsible for the death of his beloved wife. With the help of a gunslinger named Getz (Dan Duryea), Brewster embarks on a quest for vengeance.

programme.title: Man of the East
programme.desc: A dude (Terence Hill) arrives from New England with books and a bicycle, ready to claim his father's rowdy ranch.

programme.title: Death Rides a Horse
programme.desc: Having witnessed the brutal murder of his entire family by bandits at the age of 5, Bill Meceita has spent 15 years planning his vengeance. Finding a kindred spirit in Ryan, an experienced gunslinger seeking his own revenge on those who framed him, the two team up to find and kill Walcott, a fearsome bandit on the loose. But Bill soon discovers that Ryan may know more about his tragic past than he has let on.

programme.title: A Reason to Live, A Reason to Die
programme.desc: After surrendering Fort Holman to the Confederacy without there being a single shot fired, Col. Pembroke (James Coburn) faces public disgrace and a potential court-martial unless he's able to recapture the fort now held by the power-mad Maj. Ward (Telly Savalas). To help him on this mission, Pembroke enlists a ragtag bunch of condemned men who are promised their freedom should they survive. Despite much internal strife, the group gradually comes together in time for the assault.

programme.title: The Hunting Party
programme.desc: Brandt Ruger (Gene Hackman) is a rich cattle rancher. He has a bad relationship with his wife, Melissa (Candice Bergen), whom he treats like a possession. While Brandt is away from home on a hunting trip, Frank Calder (Oliver Reed), a brazen outlaw, kidnaps Melissa and holds her for ransom. Frank, however, treats Melissa better than her own husband does, and before long she begins to develop feelings for him. When Brandt returns, he's enraged and vows to take violent revenge against Frank.

programme.title: Wild Bill
programme.desc: Gunfighter Wild Bill Hickok (Jeff Bridges) travels the frontier, gaining fame and enemies in roughly equal measure. He sometimes meets up with his friend and occasional lover, Calamity Jane (Ellen Barkin), and he headlines for a while in a traveling circus. Along the way, he meets Susannah (Diane Lane), his one true love, but spurns her for the outlaw life. With his health deteriorating, Bill rides into Deadwood, S.D., as his past catches up to him.

programme.title: Quigley Down Under
programme.desc: Matthew Quigley (Tom Selleck) is an American rifleman who travels to the Australian outback to answer a help-wanted ad calling for a sharpshooter. The two men fight, and when Quigley is knocked out, Marston leaves him and a local crazy woman (Laura San Giacomo) to die in a remote part of the Outback. They're rescued, however, and plot their revenge.

programme.title: Young Billy Young
programme.desc: Fleeing the scene of a gruesome gunfight in Mexico, Billy Young (Robert Walker) arrives in the small town of Lordsburg, where he is promptly deputized by local sheriff Ben Kane (Robert Mitchum). Kane takes the troubled young man under his wing, hoping to reform his lawless ways. As the bond between the two men grows stronger, Kane recruits Young for a particularly personal assignment: to help bring to justice Frank Boone (John Anderson), a vicious outlaw responsible for the death of his son.

programme.title: Alias Jesse James
programme.desc: Foolish life insurance salesman Milford Farnsworth (Bob Hope) commits his biggest blunder yet when he unwittingly offers a six-figure policy to notorious gunslinger Jesse James (Wendell Corey). Furious, his boss orders him to repurchase the policy. James, however, parries Farnsworth's attempts with ease, robbing and humiliating him. But when James' latest scheme pairs the patsy with the bandit's sweetheart, Cora Lee Collins (Rhonda Fleming), Farnsworth and Cora begin falling in love.

programme.title: The King and Four Queens
programme.desc: The four McDade brothers stage a successful heist -- except that three of them are killed. When their wives and mother learn that only one of the young men survived with the loot, they are eager to find out which one. Slick traveler Dan Kehoe catches wind of this strange situation and decides to charm the women in hopes of eventually enjoying the spoils. Before long, however, the lonely females begin competing for Dan, disintegrating into a cut-throat battle royal for his heart.

programme.title: Three Amigos!
programme.desc: Three cowboy movie stars from the silent era -- Dusty Bottoms (Chevy Chase), Lucky Day (Steve Martin) and Ned Nederlander (Martin Short) -- are fired when one of their movies bombs. In what seems to be a career-saving offer, young Mexican woman Carmen (Patrice Martinez) offers them a high-paying gig in her village. The three jump at the opportunity, expecting to do their typical act, but Carmen believes they are really heroes and asks them to rid her village of bad guy El Guapo (Alfonso Arau).

programme.title: The Honkers

programme.title: Comes a Horseman
programme.desc: Determined single woman Ella Connors (Jane Fonda) struggles to maintain her ranch despite constant attempts by Jacob "J.W." programme.title: Woman on the Run
programme.desc: After witnessing a murder, Frank Johnson goes on the run to avoid being killed himself. His wife, Eleanor (Ann Sheridan), seems almost apathetic about finding him when questioned by Investigator Harris (Robert Keith), due to a marriage on the rocks. However, after learning that Frank has a grave heart condition, Eleanor recruits reporter Dan Leggett (Dennis O'Keefe) to help track down Frank. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: San Francisco businessman Harry Graham (Edmond O'Brien) and his wife and business partner, Eve (Joan Fontaine), are in the process of adopting a child. Discovering new love for her husband along the way, Eleanor must get to Frank before the killer does.

programme.desc: Despondent over the marriage of her ex-husband to a younger woman, a middle-aged divorcée plunges to her death from her penthouse. At the woman's funeral, her former college friends (Bette Midler, Goldie Hawn, Diane Keaton) reunite for the first time in nearly 30 years. programme.title: Charlie Moore: No Offense
programme.desc: Fishing enthusiast Charlie Moore, also known as "The Mad Fisherman," is stepping out of his comfort zone and into the worlds of his guests, but first they have to visit his. In each episode, a special guest is invited into Charlie's world, and then the roles are reversed. When it's his turn, Charlie immerses himself in the local culture of the town he visits, wanting to experience everything that makes it special, from the best places to eat to favorite fishing destinations, and nobody is safe from his comedic critiquing.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Few people love anything more than Jon Gruden loves football. Suzy Kolber digs into the singular obsession that made him a Super Bowl winner, a wildly popular Monday Night Football analyst, and a social media sensation nobody saw coming. Jon reflects on the philosophy that drove every reinvention—including how he's navigated life since his coaching career came to a sudden end—and whether the sideline is still calling.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Digit Murphy built women's hockey from the bench and the boardroom - coaching, fighting and lobbying long before the lights came on. Hilary Knight became the face of women's hockey, setting records, winning Olympic gold twice, and carrying a sport on her back. Suzy Kolber sits down with both trailblazers to examine what it costs to love a sport that didn't always love you back.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Former Canadian quarterback Sam Rapoport creates NFL paths for women while developing global flag football; Mexican quarterback Diana Flores elevates the sport internationally following a featured commercial; broadcaster Suzy Kolber interviews both leaders on taking flag football to the LA twenty twenty-eight Olympics.

programme.title: The Originals With Suzy Kolber
programme.desc: Jesse Cole, the visionary owner of the Savannah Bananas, turned a failing college summer baseball team into a $500 million entertainment empire by doing the exact opposite of what everyone else did. Suzy Kolber traces how a man in a yellow tuxedo built a global phenomenon by asking a question nobody else was: What if the fans, and true fun are the whole point? Jesse opens up about being nearly $2 million in debt and the critics who were certain he was out of his mind - right up until he wasn't.

programme.title: Beyond the Spotlight
programme.desc: Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from.".

programme.desc: Using hidden cameras, host John Quiñones observes and comments on how ordinary people behave when they are confronted with dilemmas that require them either to take action or to walk by and mind their own business. programme.title: Family Feud

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: The Price Is Right
programme.desc: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." The two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. A trio of models presents the prizes.

programme.title: Card Sharks
programme.desc: This show from legendary Mark Goodson-Bill Todman Productions features two contestants trying to predict answers to survey questions for the opportunity to play a game with oversized playing cards for a chance to win cash. One contestant guesses how many people (out of 100) gave a certain answer to a question and the other contestant then guesses if the number is higher or lower than the opponent's guess. The winning contestant then faces a row of cards and must determine if each succeeding card is higher or lower than the one that precedes it. The contestant who wins two out of three games wins the match and plays the bonus round, called Money Cards. The Money Cards round is similar to the card game in the main game but with three levels of cards instead of one row. The contestant is given $200 at the beginning of Money Cards and wagers any or all of that money when guessing if the cards will be higher or lower than the previous one. A perfect round could earn the contestant $28,800.

programme.desc: This light-hearted police drama follows a sheltered deaf woman who is about to start her first real job with the FBI. programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. programme.title: Hot Bench
programme.desc: Many popular court shows are on TV. How can the genre improve? How about using a three-judge panel? That's the concept of "Hot Bench," created by Judge Judy Sheindlin. After hearing each case, the judges discuss it among themselves before rendering a verdict. The jurists are experienced civil litigator Tanya Acker, New York State Supreme Court Justice Patricia DiMango, and former criminal defense attorney Larry Bakman. The show's title comes from a term describing a court action in which a judge frequently interrupts lawyers with questions.

programme.desc: Political analyst Marc Morial hosts a weekly syndicated newsmagazine series featuring in-depth and engaging interviews with newsmakers, influencers, business entrepreneurs, artists, health and wellness experts and social justice leaders. It has been revived as a 30-minute series after being off the air for 15 years, but has maintained the same format.

Millions of years before the dinosaurs, a world full of giant sabretooth reptiles and huge armoured herbivores was obliterated when global temperatures soared and vast deserts blanketed the land. programme.title: Walking with Monsters: Life Before Dinosaurs

As the swamps dry up, the world becomes dominated by the first ever giant reptiles - the huge, sail-backed Edaphosaurus.

programme.title: Truth for Life
programme.desc: In Health by Faith, Dr. Mark Sandoval presents a biblically grounded framework for understanding disease, healing, and the role of faith. Drawing from Scripture, Spirit of Prophecy, and clinical experience, he explains that disease is not random, but often an effort of nature to free the system from conditions created by violating God’s laws. This episode emphasizes that nine-tenths of disease have their foundation in the mind, where false beliefs, fear, guilt, bitterness, loss, and stress disrupt the nervous system and bodily function. Dr. Sandoval carefully distinguishes cause from effect, showing why treating symptoms without removing the mental and spiritual cause leads to recurring illness. Practical instruction is given on lifestyle, natural remedies, anointing, and medical care—always within the context of trusting God as the true Healer. Ultimately, the episode presents the gospel itself as God’s cure for disease, restoring health by restoring truth, identity, and faith.

programme.title: White Horse Media
programme.desc: Debates about the Godhead rage on. What does the Bible really say about the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit? Are they three separate, equal, co-eternal Persons united in one, or only two (the Father and the Son), with the Father being the “true God,” and the Holy Spirit being an invisible manifestation of the Son? In this new 5-part series, Steve Wohlberg and Kim Kjaer tackle this issue head on.

programme.title: 3ABN Worship Hour
programme.sub-title: Final Moments of Earth’s History—Daniel 11, Part Four
programme.desc: In this 3ABN-produced program, Pastor James Rafferty presents part four of his Daniel 11 study to unravel prophetic mystery. Supporting passages from Isaiah and Revelation make clear Daniel 11 is a worldwide prophecy that does not merely focus on the Middle East. Should we expect a time of peace, or prepare for a soon-coming time of trouble that will turn the world upside down? When an ominous power seeks dominion, clamps down on our civil and religious freedoms, and enforces economic restrictions to gain its purposes, no nation will escape its grasp. We can’t trust in institutions, and even country living—though helpful—will not save us. Our only hope is to stay focused on following Jesus and proclaiming the everlasting gospel. Many who were deceived by paganism will hear and be united with God’s remnant people who are settled in His truth. God will seal His people, and Jesus will stand up to deliver them IN THE TIME OF trouble.

Uncover the keys to boosting your immune system, managing stress, and overcoming unhealthy habits. Equip yourself with timeless wisdom to thrive in body and soul.

programme.title: Your Lifestyle As Medicine
programme.desc: The healing influence of nature is being increasingly recognised. The benefits of light exposure, forest therapy, and green spaces are some highlights of this emerging area of research. This program explores some of the evidence for nature as medicine, possible mechanisms, exposure recommendations and practical suggestions.

programme.title: Your Favorites By Request
programme.desc: In Revelation 22, John spoke of the river of the water of life flowing from the throne of God. Imagine yourself as part of that great crowd standing on the banks singing Shall We Gather At the River, Jesus Loves Me, and Shout To the Lord. Host Tim Parton and guest John Lomacang lead your favorites songs and share the reality of a relationship with Christ, while you are invited to worship along. Then send more requests to tim.parton@3abn.org.

programme.title: Behold the Lamb Presents
programme.desc: In a time when religious terminology often creates confusion, Scripture calls us back to clarity through diligent study and prayer. This program invites viewers to set aside human labels and explores how the Bible itself reveals the nature of God. Using the biblical term the Godhead, we discover the beautiful unity of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit—three divine Persons working together in perfect harmony for the salvation of humanity. Rooted in Scripture and centered on Christ, this message reveals the Godhead not as a theological abstraction, but as a living, loving fellowship that invites us into a deeper relationship with God.\.

programme.title: Secrets to Wellness
programme.desc: One of the most important secrets to wellness is your overall lifestyle. The choices you make can affect your health in positive or negative ways. Getting involved in the use of drugs and alcohol are some of the worst substances that affect your health. In this episode you will learn how to make healthy and positive lifestyle choices and the benefits you will receive from doing so.

programme.title: Unshackled Purpose
programme.desc: Did you know that you hold the same amount of value as the richest man in the world? Tune in to find out what this is all about.

programme.title: Raw Questions Relevant Answers
programme.desc: How do you ﬁnd and maintain a strong spiritual support group? My parents are worried that if I move out now, I won't make it on my own. .. but God will take care of me, right? How do we ﬁnd our personal footholds on the journey of life without feeling the pressures and expectations of our family?

programme.title: 3ABN Today Bible Q&A
programme.sub-title: What Does The Bible Say About That?
programme.desc: Who was Tertius, and what role did he play in writing Romans? What happened to John of Patmos after Revelation? Join us for Today Bible Q&A as our panel answers these questions and more from viewers around the world. We'll explore topics including baptism, divorce and remarriage, preserving the Earth, and Jesus' encounter with Mary after His resurrection. Bring your Bible and join us as we seek answers straight from God's Word!

programme.desc: Jesus told many parables while He was on earth. programme.desc: In this episode, Noah travels to Colorado to explore the spectacular mountains, streams, pine forest, diverse wildlife, and lush vegetation of Rocky Mountain National Park. He’ll explore how mountains were made during the global Flood by Catastrophic Plate Tectonics, then eroded as the flood waters spilled into the seas. Noah shares about the evidence for this massive erosion and wasting since the flood waters receded. He also explores how other geologic sites like Great Sand Dunes National Park and Devils Tower were built in relation to the formation and erosion of the Rockies.

programme.title: El panel de Escuela Sabática de 3ABN
programme.sub-title: Poniendo a prueba a los profetas
programme.desc: ¿Cómo podemos saber si alguien que afirma tener el don de profecía realmente está hablando en nombre de Dios? Esta lección explora las pruebas bíblicas de un verdadero profeta, comenzando con el consejo de 1 Juan 4:1 de “probar los espíritus”. Así como un diamante es examinado para comprobar su autenticidad, las afirmaciones proféticas deben ser cuidadosamente probadas por medio de las Escrituras. Von Scheibner takes advantage of his surroundings by drawing inspiration from the city's landmarks while integrating them into some of his illusions, such as teleporting across Tower Bridge. Some of Troy's tricks are more restrained, though, like when he uses his talents to help passengers get off of a bus.

programme.title: Wedding Screeners

programme.title: The Girl Who Believes in Miracles

programme.title: Pardoned by Grace
programme.desc: Drug addict and alcoholic Scott Highberger overcomes his demons and finds religion. After serving time, he becomes a pastor and runs a successful prison ministry.

programme.title: Flowers and Honey
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a city florist and the owner of an apiary business after she inherits her great aunt's farmland.

programme.title: Prescription for Love
programme.desc: A nurse fights for a chance at love with a new doctor and for a promotion to free herself from the misery her supervisor creates. As her supervisor tries to derail her chance at happiness, she learns to stand up for herself and go after her dreams.

programme.title: God's Country Song
programme.desc: A charming but troubled country singer learns he has a 5-year-old son that he didn't know existed. Struggling with alcohol addiction, he must now decide whether to raise the boy or leave his family behind to pursue his dream of musical stardom.

programme.title: Be Mine

programme.title: Princess Cut 2: Hearts on Fire
programme.desc: Robert and Lauren Anderson are finally pregnant after years of trying to start a family, but Lauren is concerned that she won't be able to maintain her boutique business and be a good mother.

programme.title: The Mask of Zorro
programme.desc: The fabled avenger trains an uncouth protégé to drive a Spanish tyrant out of California once and for all.","large":"After being imprisoned for 20 years, Zorro -- Don Diego de la Vega (Anthony Hopkins) -- receives word that his old enemy, Don Rafael Montero (Stuart Wilson), has returned. Don Diego escapes and returns to his old headquarters, where he trains aimless drunk Alejandro Murrieta (Antonio Banderas) to be his successor. Meanwhile, Montero -- who has secretly raised Diego's daughter, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), as his own -- hatches a plot to rob California of its gold.

programme.title: The Legend of Zorro
programme.desc: The masked swordsman (Antonio Banderas) and his wife (Catherine Zeta-Jones) fight a European count (Rufus Sewell) plotting to block California's statehood.","large":"A secret society, the Knights of Aragon, seeks to keep the United States from achieving manifest destiny -- and only the legendary Zorro (Antonio Banderas) can stop them. Unfortunately, Zorro, also known as Don Alejandro de la Vega, has problems of his own: His wife, Elena (Catherine Zeta-Jones), is divorcing him for spending too much time pursuing heroics and not enough being a father to their young son. But it isn't long before the whole family gets caught up in stopping the Knights.

programme.title: Open Season
programme.desc: Stranded in the wilderness, a mule deer (Ashton Kutcher) and a domesticated bear (Martin Lawrence) try to make their way back to the safety of a town preserve before a hunter catches them.","large":"Boog (Martin Lawrence), a 900-pound grizzly bear, is content entertaining tourists and living in park ranger Beth's (Debra Messing) barn. His life takes a drastic turn when he rescues a one-horned mule deer named Elliot (Ashton Kutcher) from a hunter (Gary Sinise), and is subsequently tranquilized and returned to the wild. Elliot and Boog recruit the other animals, notably a Scottish squirrel (Billy Connolly) and a beaver foreman, to help turn the tables on the hunters to make the woods safe.

programme.title: The Master of Disguise
programme.desc: A genial waiter (Dana Carvey) tries to rescue his parents from a criminal mastermind by assuming various identities.","large":"Pistachio Disguisey, a genial waiter at his father Fabrizio's Italian restaurant, possesses an uncanny knack for mimicry. What he doesn't know is that his talent is genetic, and that he is the descendant of a long line of Masters of Disguise, all of whom have inherited the secret family gift known as Energico. Initially, Pistachio is a klutz, but little by little, he learns to harness his inherited power, and sallies forth to utilize Energico to its fullest.

programme.title: Apple of My Eye
programme.desc: A tragic accident causes a young equestrian (Avery Arendes) to lose her sight and her ability to connect with anyone or anything, until a miniature horse named Apple is trained to be her companion and surrogate eyes.

programme.title: Ice Castles
programme.desc: A figure skater searches for inner strength after a tragic accident jeopardizes her future.

programme.title: Places in the Heart
programme.desc: A widowed mother fights for her cotton farm in the 1930s Texas.

programme.title: A River Runs Through It
programme.desc: Two Montana boys become different men (Craig Sheffer, Brad Pitt) under the influence of fly-fishing and their minister father (Tom Skerritt).","large":"The Maclean brothers, Paul and Norman, live a relatively idyllic life in rural Montana, spending much of their time fly-fishing. The sons of a minister, the boys eventually part company when Norman moves east to attend college, leaving his rebellious brother to find trouble back home. When Norman finally returns, the siblings resume their fishing outings, and assess both where they've been and where they're going.

programme.title: The Natural
programme.desc: The almost mythical ability of a middle-aged baseball player rockets a major-league team toward the 1939 pennant.","large":"On the way to a tryout with the Chicago Cubs, young baseball phenom Roy Hobbs (Robert Redford) is shot by the unstable Harriet Bird (Barbara Hershey). After 16 years, Hobbs returns to pro baseball as a rookie for the last-place New York Knights. Despite early arguments with his manager, Pop Fisher (Wilford Brimley), Hobbs becomes one of the best players in the league, and the Knights start winning. But this upsets the Judge (Robert Prosky), their owner, who wants Hobbs to lose games, not win.

programme.title: The Buddy Holly Story
programme.desc: The Lubbock, Texas, rock 'n' roller (Gary Busey) becomes a star with the Crickets (Don Stroud, Charles Martin Smith), then dies in a 1959 plane crash at age 22.","large":"A chronicle of the rise and brief career of rock 'n' roll star Buddy Holly (Gary Busey), who aspires to play music the way he wants it to sound. Holly and his band, the Crickets, are first invited to record in Nashville, where they encounter creative differences with the producing staff. Later they play a major booking at the Apollo Theater, scheduled there under the mistaken assumption that they're a black band. Holly's career eventually goes solo -- until the tragic day the music dies.

programme.title: Jack and Jill
programme.desc: The life of a successful, happy ad executive descends into chaos when his needy, passive-aggressive twin sister (also Sandler) makes her annual Thanksgiving visit.","large":"Thanksgiving is usually a happy time, but ad executive Jack (Adam Sandler) dreads the holiday because his twin sister, Jill (also Sandler), makes her annual visit. When Jack and his sister get off on the wrong foot, the only way to make it right is to invite her to stay through Hanukkah. But, when actor Al Pacino (Al Pacino), whom Jack desperately needs to star in a commercial, takes a shine to Jill, Jack may be forced to extend his sister's visit even longer.

programme.title: Blue Streak
programme.desc: A recently paroled thief poses as a cop in order to retrieve a gem he hid in an under-construction police station.","large":"When a heist goes wrong, thief Miles hides a diamond at a construction site before he's arrested. After serving two years, Miles returns to the location of his treasure and finds it is now a police station. Disguising himself as a recently transferred officer to infiltrate the building, Miles stops an escaping thief while trying to retrieve the jewel. Impressed by his quick action, superior Rizzo partners him with the bumbling detective Casey.

programme.title: It Could Happen to You
programme.desc: A New York policeman (Nicolas Cage) keeps his promise to split a $4 million lottery prize with a waitress (Bridget Fonda), but his wife objects.","large":"Charlie Lang (Nicolas Cage) is a simple, kindhearted New York City cop. When he realizes he has no money to tip waitress Yvonne Biasi (Bridget Fonda), Lang offers her half the winnings of his lottery ticket. Amazingly, the ticket happens to be a winner, in the sum of $4 million. True to his word, Lang proceeds to share the prize money with Biasi, which infuriates his greedy wife, Muriel (Rosie Perez). Not content with the arrangement, Muriel begins scheming to take all the money.

programme.title: Peggy Sue Got Married
programme.desc: A 1985 housewife (Kathleen Turner) passes out at her high-school reunion and wakes up in 1960, in school with her husband-to-be (Nicolas Cage).","large":"Peggy Sue Bodell (Kathleen Turner) attends her 25-year high school reunion after separating from her cheating husband, Charlie (Nicolas Cage). She regrets the decisions she has made in her life, such as getting pregnant by Charlie in high school. When she faints at the reunion, she awakens in 1960. Given the chance to relive her life, she changes many things. However, some choices are more complicated, as she begins to see young Charlie's charm and true feelings.

programme.title: Swept Away
programme.desc: While boating from Greece to Italy, a wealthy woman (Madonna) and a sailor (Adriano Giannini) become stranded on a desert island.","large":"Imagine being shipwrecked on a beautiful island -- with someone you really can't stand. A young soldier (Adriano Giannini) is cast adrift on an island with his employer, a rich, self-centered woman who is used to having her own way. Cut off from society, he reverses their roles, stripping her of pride and vanity and controlling her completely. Until, that is, she falls in love with him.

programme.title: Crazy in Alabama
programme.desc: An eccentric (Melanie Griffith) kills her abusive husband and heads to Hollywood to pursue her dreams.","large":"In 1965, eccentric Lucille Vinson murders her abusive husband, chops off his head and flees to Hollywood to pursue television fame. Back in her Alabama hometown, nephew Peejoe Bullis witnesses the killing of a young black man by racist sheriff John Doggett and is unsure whether he should testify against him. When the law catches up with Lucille, she returns home, where Peejoe is becoming increasingly involved with the civil rights movement.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: An FBI agent (Colin Hanks) must spy on his mother (Meg Ryan) after she becomes involved with a suspected art thief (Antonio Banderas).","large":"After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Last Action Hero
programme.desc: A golden ticket, a memento handed down from Houdini, puts a boy in the middle of a Hollywood superstar's lavish and secretive world.","large":"Following the death of his father, young Danny Madigan (Austin O'Brien) takes comfort in watching action movies featuring the indestructible Los Angeles cop Jack Slater (Arnold Schwarzenegger). After being given a magic ticket by theater manager Nick (Robert Prosky), Danny is sucked into the screen and bonds with Slater. When evil fictional villain Benedict (Charles Dance) gets his hands on the ticket and enters the real world, Danny and Jack must follow and stop him.

programme.title: The Green Hornet
programme.desc: The heir (Seth Rogen) to a newspaper fortune joins forces with a resourceful company employee (Jay Chou) to bring a powerful Los Angeles crime lord to justice.","large":"Britt Reid (Seth Rogen), the heir to the largest newspaper fortune in Los Angeles, is a spoiled playboy who has been, thus far, happy to lead an aimless life. After his father (Tom Wilkinson) dies, Britt meets Kato (Jay Chou), a resourceful company employee. Realizing that they have the talent and resources to make something of their lives, Britt and Kato join forces as costumed crime-fighters to bring down the city's most-powerful criminal, Chudnofsky (Christoph Waltz).

programme.title: Battle: Los Angeles
programme.desc: After the world's great cities fall, a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon make a last stand against alien invaders.","large":"For many years, humans have reported various UFO sightings around the world, fueling speculation about the existence of life on other worlds. In 2011, mankind learns the truth the hard way when alien invaders attack. One by one, the world's great cities fall, leaving Los Angeles as the battleground for humanity's last stand. It's up to a Marine staff sergeant (Aaron Eckhart) and his platoon to draw a line in the sand against a powerful enemy unlike any previously encountered.

programme.title: Close Encounters of the Third Kind: The Director's Cut
programme.desc: Close encounter of the first kind: sighting of a UFO. Close encounter of the second kind: physical evidence. Close encounter of the third kind: contact.","large":"Science fiction adventure about a group of people who attempt to contact alien intelligence. Roy Neary (Richard Dreyfuss) witnesses an unidentified flying object, and even has a "sunburn" from its bright lights to prove it. Roy refuses to accept an explanation for what he saw and is prepared to give up his life to pursue the truth about UFOs.

programme.title: Red Water
programme.desc: A shark terrorizes a divorced couple (Lou Diamond Phillips, Kristy Swanson) and three boat hijackers on a Louisiana river.","large":"Former oil rig worker John Sanders (Lou Diamond Phillips) became a Louisiana fishing captain after a tragic accident ended his career. In need of money, he agrees to help his ex-wife, Kelli (Kristy Swanson), whose company is having trouble extracting oil upriver. Meanwhile, thugs working for a Jamaican gangster head to the same bayou searching for $3 million buried underwater. Both the scientists and the criminals are menaced by a man-eating shark that can survive in fresh water.

programme.desc: Adapted by Julian Fellowes, Tim Rose Price and Gilles Paquet-Brenner.

programme.title: Christmas on Division Street
programme.desc: A boy (Fred Savage) moves to Philadelphia and meets a homeless old-timer (Hume Cronyn) who becomes his teacher and his guide.

programme.title: Annie
programme.desc: Daddy Warbucks (Albert Finney) protects little orphan Annie (Aileen Quinn) from Miss Hannigan (Carol Burnett) and crooks in Depression-era New York.","large":"An orphan in a facility run by the mean Miss Hannigan, Annie believes that her parents left her there by mistake. programme.desc: At a national park in Kenya, English game warden George Adamson (Bill Travers) and his wife, Joy (Virginia McKenna), care for three orphaned lion cubs. When Elsa is blamed for causing an elephant stampede in the nearby village, head warden John Kendall (Geoffrey Keen) demands the young lion either be trained to survive in the wilds of the Serengeti or be sent to a zoo.

programme.title: The Ambushers

programme.title: The Awful Truth
programme.desc: Jerry (Cary Grant) and Lucy (Irene Dunne) are a married couple who doubt each other's fidelity: Jerry suspects Lucy and her music teacher (Alexander D'Arcy) of spending an evening together, and Lucy is convinced Jerry lied about a business trip. When the jealous pair file for divorce, both rush into new relationships, but quickly realize their love never died. The soon-to-be-divorced husband and wife then both scramble to spoil each other's chances for newfound romance.

programme.title: The Jolson Story
programme.desc: At the turn of the 20th century, young Asa Yoelson (Scotty Beckett) decides to go against the wishes of his cantor father (Ludwig Donath) and pursue a career in show business. Gradually working his way up through the vaudeville ranks, Asa -- now calling himself Al Jolson (Larry Parks) -- joins a blackface minstrel troupe and soon builds a reputation as a consummate performer. But as his career grows in size, so does his ego, resulting in battles in business as well as in his personal life.

programme.title: Mr. Deeds Goes to Town
programme.desc: Longfellow Deeds (Gary Cooper), a resident of small-town Vermont, leads a simple life until he inherits a vast fortune from a late uncle. Soon, unscrupulous lawyer John Cedar (Douglas Dumbrille) brings Deeds to New York City, where the unassuming heir is the object of much media attention. When wily reporter Babe Bennett (Jean Arthur) gains the trust and affection of Deeds, she uses her position to publish condescending articles about him -- but are her feelings for him really that shallow?

programme.desc: When hard-charging New York newspaper editor Walter Burns discovers that his ex-wife, investigative reporter Hildy Johnson, has gotten engaged to milquetoast insurance agent Bruce Baldwin, he unsuccessfully tries to lure her away from tame domestic life with a story about the impending execution of convicted murderer Earl Williams. But when Hildy discovers Williams may be innocent, her reporter instincts take over.

programme.title: Five Easy Pieces
programme.desc: Rejecting his cultured upper-class background as a classical pianist, Robert Dupea (Jack Nicholson) opts for a blue-collar existence, working in a California oil field and spending time with his waitress girlfriend, Rayette (Karen Black). But when Robert discovers that his father is gravely ill, he wants to reunite with his estranged family in the state of Washington. He and Rayette take a road trip that brings the two paths of his life to an uncomfortable intersection.

programme.desc: When Joanna Drayton (Katharine Houghton), a free-thinking white woman, and black doctor John Prentice (Sidney Poitier) become engaged, they travel to San Francisco to meet her parents. Matt Drayton (Spencer Tracy) and his wife Christina (Katharine Hepburn) are wealthy liberals who must confront the latent racism the coming marriage arouses. Also attending the Draytons' dinner are Prentice's parents (Roy E. Glenn Sr., Beah Richards), who vehemently disapprove of the relationship.

programme.title: The Running Man
programme.desc: When pilot Rex Black (Laurence Harvey) destroys his plane in a crash the day after his insurance policy expires, the insurance company refuses to give him any money. To strike back at the agency, Rex fakes his death, changes his identity and escapes to Spain, with 50,000 pounds in life insurance money. His wife (Lee Remick) joins him in Spain, but when an insurance investigator (Alan Bates) arrives unexpectedly, Rex's paranoia causes him to flee again.

programme.title: A Woman of Distinction
programme.desc: Reserved college dean Susan Middlecott (Rosalind Russell) is all business and can't be bothered with love. However, when Susan meets charming British astronomy professor Alec Stevenson (Ray Milland), it seems that romance could be in the air. Though she resists being paired with Alec, things don't go as planned -- particularly when a publicity agent and even Susan's amiable father (Edmund Gwenn) get involved. Soon Susan may just be in love, whether she likes it or not.

programme.title: Don't Raise the Bridge, Lower the River
programme.desc: Dreamer George Lester (Jerry Lewis) continually focuses on outrageous ways to make cash, and his fed-up wife, Pamela (Jacqueline Pearce), finally decides to leave him. To impress her, he converts their home into a swinging dance club -- but she is mortified when she returns. Undeterred, George enlists his grifter buddy H. William Homer (Terry-Thomas) and concocts a bizarre moneymaking plan that involves secret blueprints, international espionage and crooked dentist Dr. Pinto (John Bluthal).

programme.title: Mickey One
programme.desc: Stand-up comic Mickey One (Warren Beatty) is fearful that the gambling debts he amassed have made him a marked man in the Detroit clubs that he frequents. Assuming a false identity, Mickey flees to Chicago, where he cautiously resumes his career at the upscale Club Xanadu. When club owner Ed Castle (Hurd Hatfield) offers Mickey a shot at auditioning for an unknown man with reputed connections in the Midwest, the increasingly paranoid Mickey fears that the mob has finally closed in on him.

programme.title: Planes, Trains and Automobiles
programme.desc: Easily excitable Neal Page (Steve Martin) is somewhat of a control freak. Trying to get home to Chicago to spend Thanksgiving with his wife (Laila Robins) and kids, his flight is rerouted to a distant city in Kansas because of a freak snowstorm, and his sanity begins to fray. Worse yet, he is forced to bunk up with talkative Del Griffith (John Candy), whom he finds extremely annoying. Together they must overcome the insanity of holiday travel to reach their intended destination.

Don’t miss out on this important series.

Included is a study of the season of the Messiah's birth, the three days and three nights and whether Christians are still required to observe the Feasts. Your faith in the God who knows the end from the beginning will be strengthened.

programme.desc: Whether you're navigating the complexities of creating relationships or seeking to deepen or mend your current relationships, this series provides invaluable wisdom for a true love and healing that lasts. Drawing from biblical principles and practical strategies, certified Life and Relationship coaches Martin and Debbie Raj share their journey, promoting forgiveness, values, self-worth and joy in Jesus. They address the prevalence of broken families and relationships marred by abusive behaviors, identity crises, lack of leadership, commitment and genuine love. They firmly believe that Happily Ever After is not a myth, but a reality attainable through following God's plan and committing to the necessary effort, with the belief that “In His presence, there is fullness of Joy.” Psalm 16:11. programme.title: Reversing Autoimmune
programme.sub-title: Why Are So Many Christians Getting Sick?
programme.desc: What are autoimmune diseases? Can they actually be reversed? At just 29 years old, Gabriel started seeing the first signs of the same autoimmune disease that killed his mother and grandmother, autoimmune liver cirrhosis. He suffered through chronic fatigue, migraine headaches, food allergies, problems sleeping, and a terrible skin fungus that covered a third of his body. However, what began as a death sentence turned into a wonderful blessing of health and discovery. With the blessing of God, through much prayer, years of research and trial and error, Gabriel Arruda successfully reversed his autoimmune disease without modern medicine. In this series, you are going to learn how diet, environmental toxins,and genes effect autoimmune diseases and what you can do about it.

programme.title: The Incredible Journey Season 7
programme.desc: Thomas Meagher was an Irish Nationalist who participated in the infamous Young Irelander Rebellion in 1848. The rebellion was a desperate attempt to gain independence from the British Crown and to set up an Irish republic. For his role in the rebellion Meagher was tried and sentenced to penal transportation to Van Diemen’s Land, (Tasmania) in Australia. He managed to escape Tasmania and make his way to New York, where through sheer force of will and determination he educated himself and began a career as a lecturer and writer. But this was by no means the end of his journey. He fought for the union during the American Civil War and later became governor of the newly minted Territory of Montana. Meagher story is one of grit and perseverance. Join us as we explore the life of Thomas Meager and take a look at grit and how our mindset can make a difference in how we achieve our goals.

programme.title: Apostasy: Theological Analysis of the Davidian Movement
programme.desc: Untangling the web of error can be exhaustingly complex. In this series, you will learn to discern the counterfeit. The Davidian Movement, often called the "Shepherd's Rod", has hooked many unsuspecting Bible students who are seeking "Present Truth". By the end of this series, you will recognize and be able to refute the major Davidian doctrines such as Ezekiel 9, the stone of Daniel 2, and the pre-millennial kingdom, as well as their commonly used Bible and Spirit of Prophecy references. You will have a clear understanding of truth by rediscovering the beauty of Adventism; guarding yourself against deception or helping someone already involved with a dissident group. Ephesians 6:11-19 tells us to put on the whole armor of God that you may be able to stand firm no matter what evil the devil sends your way. False prophets shall arise (Matt 24:11) and false theories, clothed with garments of light, will be presented to God's people… seducing influences exerted; minds hypnotized (Maranatha, Feb 20, "Beware of Satan's Agents", p.59:1). There are grievous wolves in our mists, men speaking perverse things, drawing away disciples after them (Acts 20:29-30). BEWARE! Take heed that no man deceive you (Matt 24:4). "God will arouse His people, if other means fail, heresies will come in among them...We should present sound arguments that will not only silence our opponents, but will bear the closest and most searching scrutiny.. ." (5T, 707:3 - 709). Search the Scriptures and the Spirit of Prophecy by the grace of the Holy Spirit. The speaker has done just this. Praise God! Through His miracle, Ismael was brought out of the Shepherd's Rod deception. Finally, through this series, it is time to set the record straight.
